803ede6c9d1880322e059c79e5fda7c8d534e8d5.sourceText: 如果以后把 `cpp_interface.h` 移到单独的 `inc/` 目录，就需要再用 `target_include_directories()` 把那个目录加入头文件搜索路径。当前这个例子放在同一层目录，所以不需要额外修改 CMake。
803ede6c9d1880322e059c79e5fda7c8d534e8d5.translatedText: If you later move `cpp_interface.h` to a separate `inc/` directory, you will need to use `target_include_directories()` again to add that directory to the header file search path\. In the current example, it is placed in the same directory level, so no additional modification to CMake is required\.

80579a80ca22151171f4c5e62391745815b1fef4.translatedText: > Summary: Only integer variables can be used in modulo operations\.

805f370d70c78cc7eb19d4732671fd8438d37b24.sourceText: 包内README还写过“未设置时使用空变换”，当前实现没有对应的单位变换旁路：若PCD能读取但frame为空或TF缺失，会进入重试。应以当前源码为准，本轮不修改节点或地图转换。
805f370d70c78cc7eb19d4732671fd8438d37b24.translatedText: The README in the package also stated that "an empty transform is used when unset," but the current implementation has no corresponding identity\-transform bypass: if the PCD can be read but frame is empty or the TF is missing, it enters retry\. The current source code should be taken as authoritative, and no changes will be made to the node or map transform in this round\.

806fda270c2c83f1ffd389130a36218032e578b1.sourceText: 程序运行后，`divide(10, 0)` 会抛出异常，后面的正常返回不会继续执行，程序会跳转到 `catch` 中处理异常。
806fda270c2c83f1ffd389130a36218032e578b1.translatedText: After the program runs,`divide(10, 0)` an exception will be thrown, and the subsequent normal return will not continue to execute; the program will jump to `catch` to handle the exception\.

80aa662f53d6ca8461aae3d22260ec612229e7d3.sourceText:
*  生活中我们买的电子产品都基本会有出厂设置，在某一天我们不用时候也会删除一些自己信息数据保证安全
*  C++中的面向对象来源于生活，每个对象也都会有初始设置以及 对象销毁前的清理数据的设置。
80aa662f53d6ca8461aae3d22260ec612229e7d3.translatedText:
*  In everyday life, most of the electronic products we buy come with factory settings, and one day when we no longer use them, we will also delete some of our own information and data to ensure security\.
*  C++ The object\-oriented concept in this comes from everyday life; every object also has initial settings as well as settings for cleaning up data before the object is destroyed\.

80b228e04bf6fe70e2eeed0421644f5bdd7d83fb.sourceText:
* 函数对象在使用时，可以像普通函数那样调用, 可以有参数，可以有返回值
* 函数对象超出普通函数的概念，函数对象可以有自己的状态
* 函数对象可以作为参数传递
80b228e04bf6fe70e2eeed0421644f5bdd7d83fb.translatedText:
* When a function object is used, it can be called like an ordinary function, can take parameters, and can have a return value\.
* Function objects go beyond the concept of ordinary functions; a function object can have its own state\.
* A function object can be passed as a parameter\.
